name: flip
about: The avatar crouches, jumps up and turns one full head-over-heels flip in the air, then lands on its feet with arms up and cheers.
code:
me.feel('happy')
yield* me.poseTo({ squash: 0.7, lean: 0.4, legL: { bend: 1 }, legR: { bend: 1 }, armL: { swing: -0.8 }, armR: { swing: -0.8 } }, 0.3)
w.sound('whoosh')
w.puff({ x: me.x, y: 0.05, z: me.z, kind: 'dust', count: 8 })
const y0 = me.y, h = Math.max(1.2, me.height * 0.9), T = 0.9
me.pose.squash = 1
yield* me.poseTo({ lean: 0, armL: { swing: 3 }, armR: { swing: 3 }, legL: { bend: 1.6, swing: 1.4 }, legR: { bend: 1.6, swing: 1.4 } }, 0.1)
yield* w.during(T, (k) => {
  me.y = y0 + 4 * h * k * (1 - k)
  me.pitch = -Math.PI * 2 * w.ease(k)
})
me.y = y0
me.pitch = 0
w.sound('boing')
w.puff({ x: me.x, y: 0.05, z: me.z, kind: 'dust', count: 10 })
yield* me.poseTo({ squash: 0.75, legL: { swing: 0, bend: 0.8 }, legR: { swing: 0, bend: 0.8 }, armL: { swing: 0, raise: 2.6 }, armR: { swing: 0, raise: 2.6 } }, 0.15)
yield* me.poseTo({ squash: 1, legL: { bend: 0 }, legR: { bend: 0 } }, 0.2)
w.sound('yay')
w.puff({ at: me, kind: 'star', count: 14 })
me.say({ en: 'Ta-da!', fi: 'Tadaa!' })
yield* me.jump(0.3)
yield* w.wait(0.8)
yield* me.rest()
